summary: Validated the four follow-up features on Faceless AI Reels (Background Music beds, Caption Presets — position/size, Brand Watermark, Voice Preview). Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_reels_extras.py — 8/8 pytest cases passed in ~11s including /api/config exposing caption_positions {bottom,center,top}, caption_sizes {s,m,l} and music_tracks {none,lofi,upbeat,cinematic}; GET /api/voices/{onyx|nova}/preview returns 200 audio/mpeg with non-zero body; GET /api/voices/bogus/preview returns 404; POST /api/reels rejects invalid caption_position / caption_size / music_id with 400; and a full end-to-end reel {script, voice=nova, caption_style=sunset, caption_position=bottom, caption_size=l, bg=sunset, music=upbeat, watermark=@creator} reached status=ready in ~6s, echoed back all new fields on GET /api/reels/{id}, and GET /api/reels/{id}/video returned 200 video/mp4 (>10KB). Frontend (Expo web preview @ 390x844): Create screen scrolls to STUDIO SETTINGS and shows the new Music row (testID setting-music) which opens a sheet listing No music / Lo-Fi Chill / Upbeat / Cinematic; CAPTION POSITION chips (bottom/center/top) and CAPTION SIZE chips (s/m/l) toggle correctly (testIDs caption-position-<id>, caption-size-<id>); WATERMARK text input accepts and persists text (testID watermark-input); the Voice sheet shows a preview play button per voice with correct testID preview-<voiceId> for all 6 voices (onyx, nova, shimmer, echo, fable, sage) and tapping one does not crash. No new React Native red-screen errors observed. Pre-existing warnings (props.pointerEvents deprecated, React 19 element.ref) still present from prior iteration — not caused by these features.

react_native_issues.issue: Boot warning `props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents` persists (likely from @gorhom/bottom-sheet). Non-blocking. Reference: browser console on Create screen.

Console error `Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19` fires when opening the Music/Voice OptionSheet. Non-blocking on web but should be tracked — likely @gorhom/bottom-sheet or a forwardRef consumer. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/OptionSheet.tsx (ref forwarding).

action_items: Optional: silence the React 19 `element.ref` warning by upgrading/patching @gorhom/bottom-sheet or wrapping forwardRef usage in OptionSheet.tsx.
Optional: track upstream fix for `props.pointerEvents is deprecated` warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:194 voice_preview caches the sample mp3 on disk under MEDIA_DIR — good. Consider also serving via storage_client for horizontal scale, but fine for MVP.

reels_config.py MUSIC_TRACKS uses relative paths; ensure the referenced files (chill.mp3, upbeat.mp3, cinematic.mp3) are shipped in the container — verified indirectly via successful ffmpeg amix in the end-to-end test.
server.py:230 doc build looks correct — new fields caption_position, caption_size, music_id, watermark all persisted and returned via public_reel.
seed_data_creation: One reel created and auto-deleted by test_reel_with_all_new_fields. Existing demo reels ('Octopus facts', 'Productivity hack') untouched.
